title: Omada: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
author: The Motley Fool Team
description: Omada Health reported strong Q3 2026 results with 34% year-over-year revenue growth to $91 million and raised full-year guidance. The company achieved record member retention of 2.5 years average tenure and reduced care delivery costs to an all-time low of $81 per member through AI automation. Omada's flexible GLP-1 product strategy positions it to benefit regardless of employer coverage decisions, while its $243 million cash position with no debt provides financial strength for expansion.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong Q3 results with 34% revenue growth, record member retention, all-time low care delivery costs, raised full-year guidance, positive net income, and strategic positioning around GLP-1 coverage uncertainty demonstrate solid operational execution and growth trajectory for long-term investors.

title: Compared to Estimates, Omada Health, Inc. (OMDA) Q3 Earnings: A Look at Key Metrics
author: Zacks.Com
description: Omada Health reported Q3 2026 revenue of $91.31 million, up 34.2% year-over-year, beating the consensus estimate of $85.75 million by 6.48%. EPS came in at $0.17, significantly exceeding the $0.09 estimate by 88.89%. However, total members declined to 1.1 million from the estimated 1.12 million. The stock has a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating and has underperformed the broader market, down 7% over the past month.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Mixed results: strong revenue and EPS beats (+6.48% and +88.89% respectively) with solid year-over-year growth of 34.2%, but offset by member count falling short of estimates (1.1M vs 1.12M estimate) and recent stock underperformance (-7% vs market -0.4%). The Hold rating suggests balanced risk-reward with near-term performance expected to align with the broader market.

title: Omada Health, Inc. (OMDA) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
author: Na
description: Omada Health (OMDA) reported Q3 2026 earnings of $0.17 per share, beating consensus estimates of $0.09 by 88.89%, with revenues of $91.31 million exceeding expectations by 6.48%. The company has outperformed market estimates four consecutive quarters. Peer company LifeMD is expected to report a quarterly loss of $0.14 per share with declining revenues.

title: New York Academy of Medicine Names Leaders from Hospital for Special Surgery and Omada Health to Board of Trustees
author: New York Academy Of Medicine
description: The New York Academy of Medicine announced two new Board of Trustees members: Ann Marie McDonald, senior vice president and chief nursing executive at Hospital for Special Surgery, and Thomas Tsang, chief medical officer at Omada Health. Both leaders bring extensive expertise in healthcare quality, clinical operations, and technology-enabled care delivery.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company's chief medical officer is appointed to the NYAM Board of Trustees, highlighting recognition of Omada Health's expertise in telemedicine, virtual health technologies, and innovation in healthcare delivery.

title: Omada Health to Participate in Canaccord Genuity’s 46th Annual Growth Conference
author: Na
description: Omada Health announced that senior management will participate in Canaccord Genuity's 46th annual Growth Conference in Boston on August 11, 2026, with a fireside chat. The company provides virtual healthcare services for chronic conditions and has served over two million members across 2,000+ employers and health plans.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is actively participating in major industry conferences and continues to expand its member base and service offerings. The announcement demonstrates ongoing business development and market engagement, with no negative indicators mentioned in the core announcement.
